message:
In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the bolted cross-frame connection for the added mass has quantified bolt load but missing girder fatigue review, Retrofit Integration Architect. To check it I used review of the repeated check calculation (E10) building on the optimal Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) sizing (E4). I found 4373 Newtons peak per 400 kilogram module documented, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead completes girder-level fatigue review before proposal. My position: not ready because support safety is not closed.

In the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) at midspan (C1), the off-tune comfort and stroke method has only effective damping without mapped response, Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used review of the detuned damping estimate (E8) against the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6). I found 0.064 effective damping ratio at plus 5 percent detune without acceleration mapping, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose Vibration Control Specialist adds off-tune acceleration and stroke for minus 5 percent to plus 5 percent. My position: not ready because robustness is unproven.

In the bare 40 metre footbridge baseline, the joint proposal timing has risk of early vote before integration, Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner and Structural Dynamics Lead. To check it I used standards review of the resonant response calculation (E1). I found 1.75 metres per second squared baseline above 0.5 metres per second squared limit, according to Human Induced Vibrations of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), 2008. I propose holding any proposal until the blocking process objection is resolved. My position: not ready because checks are incomplete.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: bolt load quantified, girder fatigue still open.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: off-tune acceleration and stroke still needed.
Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: girder fatigue review requested.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: comfort target held, proposal on hold.
